packageRules.description: Gradle updates land on the dependency dashboard instead of opening PRs, and never auto-land — overriding the preset's automerge of minor/patch. Two reasons, both of which expire at cutover. (1) This repository is still a COPY of modules that build and publish from compose-ai-tools; its CI checks the device-dimensions catalog against a compose-ai-tools checkout, and its publishing is hard-blocked (see docs/VERSIONING.md). Letting the toolchain drift independently creates divergence to reconcile by hand later, for no benefit while nothing here ships. (2) gradle/libs.versions.toml came across whole: 174 entries, of which the nine modules here reference about 13. Renovate reads the catalog, not the build files, so unattended it would open PRs for ~160 dependencies this repository does not consume. Prune the catalog and finish the cutover, then delete this rule — the Robolectric guard below is written to still apply.

robolectric: released versions only. Robolectric publishes a rolling `4.17-SNAPSHOT` to Sonatype and Renovate ranks it above `4.17-beta-2`, but this build declares no snapshot repository (nor should it, for a reproducible build) — so the bump resolves nowhere and fails every Android configuration. Betas and RCs are still fair game; only `-SNAPSHOT` is excluded. gradle/libs.versions.toml cites this rule by name. The preset's `-compat` filter covers the kotlinx side; this is the separate Robolectric trap.
